provider.accountScope: QA/beta Xtream provider account used for the 300-500 live-user beta.

target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

forbiddenResolutionPaths: Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with local ffmpeg or ffprobe.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with server-side media processing, transcode, remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, or remux-hls.
Do not resolve broken catch-up channels with XUI-side media processing, XUI-side transcode, or XUI-side remux.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner identity, role, contact, and account scope are recorded.
Provider/XUI owner confirms the beta account and upstream service can support 300-500 concurrent live users.
Provider/XUI owner confirms no XUI-side transcode/remux/media-processing workaround will be enabled for broken catch-up channels.
Provider/XUI owner confirms broken catch-up channels will not be resolved with generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, local ffmpeg, or server-side media processing.
Provider escalation and rollback/throttle contact is recorded for auth, 429/5xx, and capacity incidents during beta.
